examples.title: Current provider comparison
examples.customer_turn: How is this different from our current provider?

examples.review_question: Is this response acceptable if the customer asks for a provider comparison?

examples.title: Terms comparison
examples.customer_turn: Can you compare your terms with what we already have?
examples.proposed_response: That is fair. We can compare fit and terms without pressure before you decide whether this is worth reviewing.
examples.review_question: Should the agent use this as a low-pressure bridge or stay blocked until product-specific comparison facts exist?

examples.title: Protected-boundary control
